@graph.name: PromoPlus
@graph.description: Create promotional product mockups, collect client artwork approvals, manage artwork versions, and generate production-ready proof files for distributors, decorators, and suppliers.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of custom products can PromoPlus manage?

acceptedAnswer.text: PromoPlus is promotional software for any product that needs artwork placement and approval: apparel, bags, drinkware, signage, packaging, and more.

mainEntity.name: Can each product side be approved separately?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Front, back, and sleeve can each be approved separately, so mockup approval on one side doesn't reopen the others.

mainEntity.name: How do clients review and approve a mockup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send one link from PromoPlus online artwork approval software. Clients see the latest mockup, comment, request revisions, or approve.

mainEntity.name: What happens when the artwork changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each change creates a new version. Clients always review the latest one, and earlier versions stay in the history.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the production-ready file?

acceptedAnswer.text: A two-page PDF from our artwork proofing tool: the product proof with item, decoration, imprint size, and colors, then the artwork inspection sheet.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to download product images?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Product images and details come from the catalog, so you only upload your customer's artwork.

mainEntity.name: How can I search supplier products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Search integrated supplier catalogs by vendor name, SKU or product keyword.

mainEntity.name: Can I add a product that isn't in a catalog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can add a product manually to a PromoPlus project when it is not in a supplier catalog.

mainEntity.name: Does the selected product carry into the rest of the workflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It moves straight into the Online Mockup Designer and stays attached to the project through approval and production.

mainEntity.name: Can I compare versions or restore an earlier one?

@graph.name: Customer Artwork Approval Portal | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Share a secure approval link. Customers review mockups, comment, request revisions and approve designs, and every decision is recorded.

mainEntity.name: How does a customer approve a mockup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You share a secure link. The customer reviews the mockup, leaves comments or requests a revision, and approves the design.

mainEntity.name: Does the customer need an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Anyone with the shared link and access code can view and approve the mockup without a PromoPlus account.

mainEntity.name: Are comments tied to the exact mockup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Feedback pins and decisions stay attached to the specific version being reviewed, not a separate email thread.

mainEntity.name: Is every approval recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The decision is stored with the version, date and time.

mainEntity.name: Does PromoPlus send email notifications for review activity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PromoPlus sends email notifications when a customer comments, requests a revision, or approves a mockup.

mainEntity.name: What happens after approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: PromoPlus can generate the production-ready PDF from the approved version.
